summary: T3 Defense Inc., formerly Nukkleus, filed an 8-K reporting that on August 28, 2026 it executed a Cancellation Agreement with Project 35 Ltd. and seller X S.A. Security and Defense Ltd., unwinding its previously disclosed acquisition of 60% of Project 35. The seller returned 168,479 T3 shares, which revert to authorized-but-unissued status, and returned/cancelled the company's $1,250,000 12% note maturing July 5, 2027; T3 returned the 60% equity stake, restoring pre-deal positions with mutual releases, including T3's Project 35 funding obligation. The parties continue discussing a possible joint venture or product purchases. Separately, T3 disclosed share count rose to 3,008,775 after issuing 1,344,969 shares via S-8, preferred conversions and warrant exercises. Watch for any revived transaction or dilution overhang.
